issues.problem: Unit error: FY2022 revenue was $198.3 billion, not million.

issues.quote: which suggests cost growth absorbed the revenue gains
issues.problem: Misleading: operating income rose ~6% (~$83.4B to ~$88.5B). Net income was flat mainly because the effective tax rate rose (~13% to ~19%, with FY2022 helped by a one-time tax benefit), not because of cost growth. Operating margin held at about 42%.

data.summary: The figures match Microsoft's FY2023 results (the 0.5% net income decline is correct on unrounded values). But FY2022 revenue is wrongly given as $198.3 million instead of billion, and the analysis blames flat net income on costs when the real cause was a higher tax rate.
